diagnose_compile_error: diagnose a compilation error during a Python C extension build by checking for missing Python.h
diagnose_attribute_error: diagnose an AttributeError during build caused by missing _needs_stub in older setuptools versions
diagnose_build_ext_error: diagnose a build_ext error by dispatching to the appropriate diagnostic function based on error type
compile_c_source: compile a C source string using a distutils compiler in a temporary directory
expect_compile_success: expect a C source string to compile successfully and raise an error if it fails
